This 2014 Ram 1500 Big Horn Crew Cab 4x4 is the kind of older half-ton that still checks a lot of the right boxes: 5.7L HEMI V8 power, an 8-speed automatic, heated seats and steering wheel, navigation, a power sunroof, and factory towing equipment. Finished in Maximum Steel Metallic Clearcoat, it combines the HEMI with an Electric Shift-On-Demand Transfer Case and 3.55 rear axle ratio for a strong mix of everyday drivability and truck capability.

The exterior gets the classic Big Horn treatment with 20-inch chrome-clad aluminum wheels, a bright billet-style grille, fog lamps, dual rear exhaust with bright tips, and HEMI badging. A factory spray-in bedliner adds useful protection to the bed, while the Power Sunroof is an uncommon and desirable addition on a pickup of this era.

Inside, this truck is considerably better equipped than a basic Big Horn. Premium cloth bucket seats, heated front seats, a heated steering wheel, 10-way power driver's seat with power lumbar, full-length floor console, and rear 60/40 split-folding seat create a comfortable and functional cabin. The Luxury Group adds details including power heated folding mirrors, auto-dimming mirrors, illuminated vanity mirrors, and a Universal Garage Door Opener.

For 2014, the technology package was impressive. Uconnect 8.4AN with an 8.4-inch touchscreen and GPS Navigation is joined by HD Radio, Integrated Voice Command with Bluetooth, a media hub, SD card slot, and a 9-speaker amplified audio system with subwoofer.

The Remote Start and Security Group adds Remote Start and a security alarm, while the Rear Camera and Park Assist Group provides both a ParkView Rear Back-Up Camera and ParkSense Front/Rear Park Assist Systemespecially useful equipment on a full-size Crew Cab pickup.

Ram also equipped this truck for real pickup duty. A Class IV Receiver Hitch, heavy-duty engine cooling, heavy-duty transmission oil cooler, 6,900-pound GVWR, and 3.55 rear axle ratio complement the HEMI V8 and 4x4 drivetrain.

The 2014 Ram 1500 was also one of the most acclaimed pickups of its time. MotorTrend named the Ram 1500 its 2014 Truck of the Year, giving Ram back-to-back Truck of the Year wins, while the model was also recognized for the refinement and innovation that helped reshape expectations for a full-size pickup.

With its 5.7L HEMI V8, 8-speed automatic, 4x4, 20-inch chrome-clad wheels, heated seats and steering wheel, Power Sunroof, Uconnect 8.4AN Navigation, 9-speaker amplified audio, Remote Start, ParkView camera, ParkSense Front/Rear Park Assist, spray-in bedliner, and Class IV Receiver Hitch, this 2014 Ram 1500 Big Horn is an unusually well-equipped example that still offers an appealing combination of HEMI performance, comfort, technology, towing capability, and classic Ram truck styling.

This 2018 Hyundai Elantra GT Sport is a sporty, practical hatchback that delivers turbocharged performance, premium features, and everyday versatility in one sharp package. Finished in Black Noir Pearl over a Black leather interior, the GT Sport gives you the usefulness of a hatchback without giving up the fun-to-drive character enthusiasts appreciate. With its 1.6L turbocharged engine, 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission, heated leather seats, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, and advanced safety features, this is much more than a basic compact car.

Performance & Driving
Under the hood is a 1.6L turbocharged 4-cylinder engine paired with a quick-shifting 7-speed automatic transmission and front-wheel drive. Multi-link rear suspension, four-wheel disc brakes, ABS, Brake Assist, traction control, and stability control help deliver responsive handling. This is a great choice for someone who wants an efficient daily driver that still has some personality when the road gets interesting.

Sporty Exterior
Black Noir Pearl gives this Elantra GT Sport a clean, aggressive appearance. Exterior equipment includes aluminum wheels, LED headlights, automatic headlights, daytime running lights, a rear spoiler, integrated turn-signal mirrors, heated power mirrors, chrome-accented black grille, body-colored bumpers and door handles, variable-speed intermittent wipers, rear defrost, privacy-tinted glass, and hatchback rear cargo access.

Interior & Comfort
Inside, the GT Sport offers Black leather seating with heated front seats, bucket seats, a leather-wrapped steering wheel, adjustable steering wheel, dual-zone automatic climate control, keyless entry, push-button start, power windows and locks, rear bench seat with pass-through capability, cargo shade, cargo-area lighting, multiple 12-volt power outlets, and illuminated vanity mirrors.

Technology
Stay connected with Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, Bluetooth, smart-device integration, HD Radio, satellite radio, AM/FM audio, auxiliary audio input, steering-wheel audio controls, two front LCD monitors, six speakers, a trip computer, and a back-up camera. Smartphone integration makes it easy to bring your favorite music, messages, maps, and compatible apps along for the drive.

Safety & Security
Safety equipment includes Blind Spot Monitor, Rear Cross-Traffic Alert, back-up camera, tire-pressure monitoring, traction control, stability control, ABS, Brake Assist, child safety locks, security system, immobilizer, side-impact beams, and a comprehensive airbag system including front, side, head, and knee airbags. Blind Spot Monitoring and Rear Cross-Traffic Alert are especially useful in busy parking lots and highway driving.

Why Buy This Elantra GT Sport?
The Elantra GT Sport is a unique combination of performance and practicality. You get turbocharged power, a 7-speed transmission, sport-oriented suspension hardware, heated leather seats, modern smartphone connectivity, advanced safety technology, and the cargo flexibility of a hatchback. It's an excellent alternative to a traditional compact sedan and a great option for shoppers considering sporty hatchbacks such as the Volkswagen Golf, Honda Civic Hatchback, Mazda3 Hatchback, or similar vehicles.

This 2005 Chrysler PT Cruiser GT Convertible Dream Cruiser Series 4 is a limited-production version of Chrysler's retro-styled convertible, combining exclusive colors and trim with the performance of the GT's turbocharged drivetrain. Finished in the Series 4-exclusive Deep Lava Red with a coordinating maroon cloth convertible top, this example currently shows just 43,734 miles. The special edition was introduced in conjunction with Detroit's famous Woodward Dream Cruise and represented the first convertible in Chrysler's Dream Cruiser series.



Under the hood is Chrysler's 2.4L High Output turbocharged DOHC four-cylinder, factory rated at 220 horsepower and 245 lb-ft of torque. Dream Cruiser Series 4 models were available with either a five-speed Getrag manual or four-speed automatic with AutoStick. The package was based on the range-topping PT Cruiser Convertible GT and also included a sport-tuned suspension, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, traction control, and 17-inch Satin Silver-finished wheels.



The Series 4 received considerably more than a unique paint color. Exterior details include chrome grille accents, special Dream Cruiser Series 4 badging, and color-coordinated trim. Inside, the special-edition treatment continues with Light Pearl Beige leather performance seats featuring perforated inserts and maroon accents, embossed Chrysler wing logos on the front headrests, Dream Cruiser embroidered floor mats, and Deep Lava Red dashboard accents. A Light Pearl Beige convertible-top boot was also designed to coordinate with the interior.



Equipment was generous for the period, including heated front seats, air conditioning, power windows, locks and mirrors, remote keyless entry, fog lamps, a leather-wrapped steering wheel, HomeLink, and a compass/temperature rearview mirror. One particularly interesting Series 4 feature is its premium 368-watt Infinity audio system, an eight-channel digitally amplified setup specifically tuned for the PT Cruiser interior and paired with an in-dash six-disc CD changer.



This example also benefits from an extensive documented history. CARFAX reports four previous owners, 32 service-history records, no accidents or damage reported, no indication of an odometer rollback, and no title-brand problems. The car spent much of its earlier life in California before moving to Indiana in 2021.

Recent documented maintenance includes a battery replacement in March 2025, followed by A/C service, an oil and filter change, and replacement of the thermostat and thermostat housing/gasket in July 2025. A coolant flush and maintenance inspection followed in September 2025.



With only 43,734 miles, its 220-horsepower High Output turbo engine, exclusive Deep Lava Red finish, maroon convertible top, special leather interior, and Dream Cruiser-specific equipment, this is considerably more than an ordinary PT Cruiser. The Series 4 represents one of the most distinctive factory versions of the PT Cruiser and combines genuine limited-edition character with top-down driving and surprisingly strong turbocharged performance.

Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Driver Attention Alert - Snap To it. Sometimes the drive is boring, sometimes you're tired, sometimes your mind starts to drift. description:
====== 2005 MERCEDES-BENZ SL65 AMG ROADSTER ======

*VIN: WDBSK79F45F093918*
*47,507 MILES | SILVER OVER GRAY | 6.0L BI-TURBO V12 | AMG | HARDTOP CONVERTIBLE*

Okay...

I had an entire introduction planned for this car.

Then I realized...

====== IT'S AN SL65 AMG. ======

If you know...

====== YOU'RE ALREADY LOOKING FOR YOUR KEYS. ======

And if you don't know?

Allow me about 30 seconds to ruin every other SL you've been shopping for.

----------------------------------------

====== 6.0-LITER. ======

====== BI-TURBO. ======

====== V12. ======

That's it.

That's the ad.

We can all go home.

Actually, no.

Because Mercedes-Benz apparently decided a luxury convertible needed a *hand-built twin-turbocharged V12 producing 604 horsepower and 738 lb-ft of torque.*

====== IN 2005. ======

Read that again.

====== 738 LB-FT. ======

In a two-seat Mercedes roadster.

Because apparently Germany was completely unsupervised in the early 2000s.

----------------------------------------

====== THIS IS NOT AN SL500. ======

Not an SL55.

Not an SL with AMG wheels.

====== SL65 AMG. ======

The big one.

The ridiculous one.

The one Mercedes built for the person who walked into the dealership and said:

*'What's the most unnecessary version?'*

====== THIS. ======

----------------------------------------

====== AND THIS ONE HAS 47,507 MILES. ======

Not 147,000.

====== FORTY-SEVEN THOUSAND. ======

Silver.

Gray interior.

And the condition?

====== DEAD NEW. ======

You don't have to squint.

You don't have to use your imagination.

You don't have to listen to somebody explain that 'it's really clean for the year.'

====== NO. ======

IT'S CLEAN.

Period.

----------------------------------------

====== THE LAST OWNER DIDN'T JUST OWN IT. ======

====== THEY PAMPERED IT. ======

Service.

Care.

Condition.

Preservation.

This thing even came to us with its *CAR COVER.*

That's the kind of previous owner you want when you're buying a 20+ year-old V12 AMG.

Some people park their car.

====== THIS GUY TUCKED IT INTO BED. ======

Probably whispered goodnight to it.

And after seeing the condition?

====== WE'RE NOT EVEN MAKING FUN OF HIM. ======

We understand.

----------------------------------------

====== AND THEN YOU START LOOKING AROUND IT. ======

AMG bodywork.

AMG wheels.

Massive AMG brakes.

Quad exhaust.

Retractable hardtop.

Leather everywhere.

Wood trim.

Luxury everywhere you touch.

And underneath all that civilized Mercedes-Benz behavior...

====== TWO TURBOS ARE FORCE-FEEDING A V12. ======

This car has absolutely no idea what personality it wants.

Luxury roadster?

Grand tourer?

Autobahn missile?

Convertible?

====== YES. ======

----------------------------------------

====== PUT THE TOP DOWN. ======

Now you're cruising.

Quiet.

Comfortable.

Classy.

Silver Mercedes.

Nothing to see here.

Then your right foot moves approximately three inches.

====== OH. ======

====== THERE'S THE V12. ======

This is the kind of car where the passenger asks:

*'Why are we going this fast?'*
